senses.gloss:
Ease,Ⓒs.ⒹsuKaM, sOKyaM, viSrAmaH, nirvfti f., nirudvegatA, svAsTyaM, svasTatA; ‘I am at e(ase)’ labDaM svAsTyaM mayA; ahaM nirvftaH, vItaciMtaH; ‘this my soul is completely at e(ase)’ jAto mamAyaM viSadaH prakAmaM aMtarAtmA (S. 4); ‘at oneʼs e(ase)’ yaTAkAmaM, paryAptaM, ya-TecCaM, prakAmaM, suKena, suKa in comp., a-kutoBayaM, nirvftyA; ‘sleeping at e(ase)’ suKa-supta.
Ⓑ
 2 sOkaryaM, anAyAsaH, sukaratvaM, suKaM, lIlA.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹlaGayati (D.), laGUkf 8 U, pra upa-Sam c. (Samayati), sAM (SAM)tv 10; hf 1 P, apanI 1 P; ‘e(ase) from griefs, burden &c. &c.’ duHKAt &c. muc c., duHKaM-BAraM-apanI, udDf, &c.
ⓃEasy,Ⓒa.Ⓓsukara, ayatnasADya, anAyAsa, suKasADya.
Ⓑ
 2 suboDa, sugama, avizama; agahana; gen. ex. by suKa or su in comp., ajYaH suKamArADyaH; bA-lAnAM suKaboDAya, &c.; ‘e(asy) of utterance’ suKoccArya; ‘e(asy) style’ sugamA BAzAsaraRiH; ‘e(asy) to get’ sulaBa, suKalaBya, &c.; ‘e(asy) in going’ suKacAra; ‘e(asy) case’ niHSalyorTaH.
Ⓑ
 3 nirvfta, susTa, nircita, svasTa, suKin, ni-rudvega, SAMta, vItaciMta, nirvftimat, viSada; ‘e(asy) circumstances’ susTiti f., dravyAnu-kUlyaM; ‘heart, be not une(asy)’ hfdaya mA uttAmya (S. 1).
Ⓑ
 4 anukUla, anuroDin, anuviDAyin.
Ⓝ[Easi]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹanAyAsena, suKaM, suKena, ayatnena, lIlayA, aSrameRa, sukaraM, akleSaM, sOkaryeRa; su or suKa in comp.
Ⓑ
 2 nirudvegaM, niScitaM, svAsTyena.
Ⓑ
 3 sAvakASaM, yaTAvasaraM.
Ⓝ[Easy]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹsOkaryaM, anAyAsaH, suKasADyatA.
Ⓑ
 2 sugamatvaM, avEzamyaM.
Ⓑ
 3 SAMti f., svAsTyaM, akleSaH, suKaM.
Ⓑ
 4 anuroDaH, Anu-kUlyaM, anuvartanaSIlatA.

East,Ⓒs.ⒹpUrvadiS f., pUrvA, prAcI, pUrvASA, EMdrI.
Ⓑ
 2 pUrvadeSaH, pOrastyajanapadaH.
Ⓝ⒈ [East]erly, [East]ern,Ⓒa.ⒹpUrva, prAc (cI f.), pOrastya, prAcya, prAcIna, pUrvadeSIya, pUrvadiksTa; prAN-muKa; ‘the mountain is e(asterly) of the sea’ samudrAd giriH pUrvaH; ‘the e(astern) mountain’ udayaH, udaya-giriH-SElaH-acalaH, pUrvAcalaH.
Ⓝ⒉ [East]erly, [East]ward,Ⓒadv.ⒹpUrveRa, pUrvasyAM diSi puraH, pUrvaM, prAk, purastAt, pUrvadeSe.
